environment: Real Electron 44.10.2 window on the local Linux PC, original OpenBot and Intelligence on the authorized VM
scope: Native chat send/stream/save/app-restart/reopen and appearance/navigation observations; further issue #6 tool/approval acceptance is separate.

fullVitest.skippedReason: Opt-in simulated-IPC live backend test; actual native Electron live test ran separately.

validation.realRustCoreIntegration: Included in full suite with existing core binary, no Rust rebuild
validation.nativeSendClick: Normal pointer click; support bubble no longer intercepts
validation.internalSystemMessages: Excluded from visible transcript while preserved in agent context
validation.originalUserData: Unused; all app testing uses an isolated scratch profile

identity.identitySource: Main process directly decodes GetUserProfile from the native core
identity.persistentOwnerBinding: 0700 directory and 0600 owner.json, verified on the actual profile
identity.cookies: Separate persistent Electron partition per identity
identity.signOut: Synchronous lease invalidation, HTTP/WS/SSH cancellation, serialized cookie clearing before native auth transition returns
identity.differentIdentity: Denied before backend connection; explicit reconnect configuration belongs to #7
identity.coverage: Session state, registered IPC, delayed cookie writes and identity transitions covered by focused tests within the full suite

reuse: Source and per-component mappings under src/renderer/features/hyper-openbot/REUSE.md; original MIT license retained
limits: Current private SSH connection targets the authorized development VM and requires Linux. Portable configuration/lifecycle remains #7.
Electron development launch used a process-only --no-sandbox flag because the npm helper lacks root ownership/mode; no source/system sandbox setting changed. Production packaging is not validated.
Appearance tests ran on the earlier native UI code before the main-process identity fix; UI styling did not change afterward.
Approved/denied tool actions, disconnect/cancel workflows and remaining phase-1 acceptance are not established by the plain-chat observations.
This is development acceptance, not a production release or complete Epic acceptance.
